note: Names only, never values. The ingestion code reads exactly these shared publisher keys; check_baseline_run compares this list with the code and the queue.

secrets.name: bls_api_key
secrets.provision: The owner creates the secret by hand in AWS Secrets Manager in the target account and region under this exact name, with no project prefix, and stores the BLS API v2 registration key as its plain text value. A key made only of digits, e, E, plus, minus and dot is refused, so the owner rotates such a key. Neither Terraform nor an agent reads the value. The publisher task role reads exactly this secret through job_publisher_keys.json (publisher_keys_enabled and publisher_secret_arns).
secrets.read_by: scripts/acquisition/bls_api_transport.py, through api_keys.checked_read (on the host the task role's read_api_key in scripts/acquisition/task_role.py), for the plan's credential_reference
secrets.used_for: The 260 BLS API requests of the queue; the rolling 24-hour limit of 450 requests applies.

secrets.name: census_api_key
secrets.provision: The owner creates the secret by hand in AWS Secrets Manager in the target account and region under this exact name, with no project prefix, and stores the Census API key as its plain text value. Neither Terraform nor an agent reads the value. The publisher task role reads exactly this secret through job_publisher_keys.json (publisher_keys_enabled and publisher_secret_arns).
secrets.read_by: scripts/acquisition/census_acs_api_transport.py, through api_keys.checked_read (the detailed collector reuses its request function and names the same secret in its plan)
secrets.used_for: The Census ACS API collectors. No unit of the bootstrap queue uses them, so the bootstrap does not need this key; a later ACS API run does.

Neither Terraform nor an agent reads the value. The publisher task role reads exactly this secret through job_publisher_keys.json (publisher_keys_enabled and publisher_secret_arns).
secrets.read_by: scripts/acquisition/hud_api_transport.py, through api_keys.checked_read (on the host the task role's read_api_key in scripts/acquisition/task_role.py), for the plan's credential_reference
secrets.used_for: The 20 HUD API requests of the queue (2021 Q2 to 2025 Q4).
